ai_review.summary: Exciting show highlighted by Bruce Hornsby's debut and the final Gimme Some Lovin', with recording source unspecified but presumed adequate.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about this performance as a turning point for the Dead, noting it was Bruce Hornsby’s first night on keyboards and the last time ‘Gimme Some Lovin’' appeared in the setlist—also the only rendition without Brent Mydland. While no concrete details about the tape source are given, the 5‑star rating suggests the recording is at least listenable.
